description: Deploy live and PROVE it: vendor the engine, cdk deploy under simi-ops/us-east-1, inject the real API URL into web/index.html, re-upload + invalidate CloudFront, then curl the API (/health, /seed, /reports, /analyze demo) and the CloudFront root to prove a live, populated, no-auth app. Depends on FEAT-001, FEAT-002, FEAT-003.
steps: Create scripts/deploy.sh (bash, set -euo pipefail) that exports AWS_PROFILE=simi-ops AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-east-1 and runs the full flow; make it idempotent/re-runnable.
Step: cp engine/depth_engine.py lambda/depth_engine.py (vendor the engine beside the handler).
Step: cd cdk; create venv if missing; pip install -r requirements.txt; cdk deploy KingaMajiStack --require-approval never --outputs-file outputs.json.
Step: parse ApiUrl and CloudFrontURL from cdk/outputs.json (python3 -c json read).

Step: rewrite web/index.html replacing __API_URL__ with the real ApiUrl (write to a built copy or in place), then push the final asset: either re-run cdk deploy (BucketDeployment re-uploads+invalidates) OR aws s3 cp the index.html to the bucket and aws cloudfront create-invalidation --paths '/*'. Prefer whichever reliably lands the API-injected file.
Step: POST <ApiUrl>/seed once to persist SAMPLE_REPORTS in DynamoDB.

Verification curls (all must pass): /health 200; /reports 200 with a non-empty reports array; /analyze demo 200 with depth_m + trace; CloudFront root 200 and body contains 'leaflet' and the injected API URL (not the placeholder).
On any Bedrock/region error during a real-image path, confirm the demo path still works (ship gate only needs demo + map live). Document SNS as a best-effort publish (logged), not a live phone flow.
Print the final live CloudFront URL and API URL as the deliverable; record them in FEAT-004 findings and set task.json status completed.
acceptance_criteria: cdk deploy completes (stack CREATE/UPDATE_COMPLETE) under account 888577033943 / us-east-1.
web/index.html served by CloudFront contains the real API URL, not __API_URL__.
curl <ApiUrl>/reports returns HTTP 200 with a non-empty reports array (after /seed).
curl -X POST <ApiUrl>/analyze with demo body returns HTTP 200 including depth_m and a non-empty trace.
curl <CloudFrontURL> returns HTTP 200 and HTML containing a Leaflet map, reachable with no auth.
The live CloudFront URL and API URL are reported.
verification: bash scripts/deploy.sh  (runs deploy + all curl checks; must exit 0)
aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name KingaMajiStack --region us-east-1 --query 'Stacks[0].StackStatus' --output text  (expect *_COMPLETE)

curl -s -X POST "$API/analyze" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"demo":true,"settlement":"Mathare","reference_object":"doorframe"}' | python3 -c 'import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);assert "depth_m" in d and d.get("trace");print("ANALYZE_OK",d["depth_m"])'
findings:
SHIPPED LIVE on AWS account 888577033943 / us-east-1 (profile simi-ops). Stack KingaMajiStack = UPDATE_COMPLETE.

LIVE URLS:
  CloudFront (public no-auth app): https://d3eujpe11u21wb.cloudfront.net
  API base: https://dh0959qwna.execute-api.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
  DynamoDB table: KingaMajiStack-ReportsTable282F2283-1HL3YJG9G8CFC
  SNS topic: arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:888577033943:KingaMajiStack-AlertsTopic3414BE91-PdZuc58OagS1

Created scripts/deploy.sh (set -euo pipefail; pins AWS_PROFILE=simi-ops AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-east-1; idempotent/re-runnable). Flow: vendor engine (cp engine/depth_engine.py lambda/) -> cdk venv + pip install -> cdk deploy using the LOCAL CDK CLI 2.1144 from cdk/node_modules (required: global 2.1033 is too old for aws-cdk-lib 2.272 cloud-assembly schema) -> read ApiUrl+CloudFrontURL from cdk/outputs.json -> inject real API URL into web/index.html -> re-run cdk deploy so BucketDeployment re-uploads+invalidates -> POST /seed -> curl proofs. CloudFront HTML check retries to tolerate post-invalidation propagation (initial run saw one transient empty body; retry resolves it).

PROOF (all pass, no auth):
  GET  /health  -> 200
  GET  /reports -> 200, non-empty reports array (seeded SAMPLE_REPORTS + live /analyze writes)
  POST /analyze {demo:true,settlement:Mathare,reference_object:doorframe} -> 200, depth_m=0.95, 9-step deterministic trace (engine computes all metres; vision LLM returns pixels only)
  GET  CloudFront root -> 200, HTML contains 'leaflet' and the injected API URL; placeholder __API_URL__ gone

NOTES: Ship gate met on the demo path + live populated Leaflet map, independent of any real-image Bedrock Nova call. Real-image path is wired (Bedrock Converse, pixel-only prompt) but not required for the gate. SNS is best-effort publish+log inside /analyze (never blocks a request); not a live phone/SMS flow. Second deploy.sh run was a 0s no-op, confirming idempotency.
